claude-s · ugc-edit

A creator cut from a placeholder talking head

this is what i mean by ugc editing, listen to the sfx. no real video, so use a template: a founder on why they ship small, vertical. plus a short screen-recording tutorial.

What the skill did

  • With no footage, it voiced a 110-word script with Chatterbox and drew A, B and wide cams of a silhouette on a set, with mouths driven by the voice and a ground-truth matte. Slipway is a made-up brand.
  • The cuts follow the words: each lands at the next word minus 0.08 s. A filler 'um' and a stray 'Oh' were cut, and 4 s of pauses removed: 21 shots, 28.5 s, ASL 1.36 s.
  • The camera never sits still: zoom-settles, slides, a keyword pull-back and pushes. Captions are a small lead-in typed on the word onsets, plus one keyword per phrase in the brand's orange that cools to white like a fuse. 'small' sits behind the speaker.
  • Inserts for the abstract nouns: a B&W montage for 'six months', a UI acted out on the words (the click lands on 'just'), a die struck out for 'not a bet', an exposure flash and an end card.
  • The second clip is the tutorial preset on a drawn app recording: the window at 82 % on the brand ground, 2-2.4x spring zooms, an oversized cursor with click discs, typing sped up about 6x, and a dry voice at -16 LUFS.
  • The review checks it: 20 of 20 cuts have a sound, 8 of 8 subs land on a cut, and the final mix is transcribed back at a 1 % word error rate.

Sound

  • Sub, +6 dB over the voice and below 150 Hz only: a boom on every cut into or out of an insert, thump-thump-boom when a keyword slams in on a cut, and a swell that stops dead on the flash cut.
  • Air, -14 dB: a passby peaking 50 ms before each plain cut, a suck-in ending on each keyword, and a flash hit on the flash and into the montage.
  • Micro, -14 dB: a key tap per typed character, a click, a click cluster when the results land, and a glitch on the struck die.
  • A slow pad, a chord every ~3.6 s, ducked 8 dB under the voice. It drops out under 'silence' and rises into the end card. Mastered to -14 LUFS at -1 dBTP.
